papers.title: Enhanced Osseointegration of Porous Titanium Modified with Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-8.
papers.abstract: Nanoscale zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8)-modified titanium (ZIF-8@AHT) can enhance osteogenesis in vitro. In this study, we systematically and quantitatively examined the effects of ZIF-8@AHT on osteogenesis, and investigated its ability to form bone in vivo. First, we coated various quantities of nanoscale ZIF-8 crystals on alkali- and heat-treated titanium (AHT) by controlling the concentration of the synthesis solution. We then characterized the ZIF-8@AHT materials using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), powder X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), and determination of the sessile drop contact angle. To illustrate the combined effects of micro/nanotopography and ZIF-8@AHT composition on bone regeneration, we cultured MC3T3-E1 preosteoblast cells on various titanium substrates in vitro by setting pure titanium (Ti) and AHT as control groups. The ZIF-8@AHTs enhanced cell bioactivity compared with AHT and Ti, as evidenced by increased extracellular matrix (ECM) mineralization, collagen secretion and the upregulated expression of osteogenic genes (Alp, Col1, Opg, and Runx2) and osteogenesis-related proteins (ALP and OPG). ZIF-8@AHT-1/8 exhibited better osteogenic activity compared with the other ZIF-8@AHT groups investigated. We subsequently inserted Ti, AHT, and ZIF-8@AHT-1/8 implants into the healed first molars (M1s) of mice, and found that ZIF-8@AHT-1/8 also promoted osseointegration at the bone-implant interface. These results suggest that ZIF-8@AHT-1/8 has great potential for practical application in implant modification.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钛表面ZIF-8涂层增强骨整合，不涉及增材制造或多孔结构设计。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design, no mechanical testing or fatigue analysis, and no consideration of stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钛植入体骨整合能力，通过MOF涂层改性。
summary_zh.method: 在碱热处理钛表面生长不同量ZIF-8晶体，表征并测试成骨活性。
summary_zh.result: ZIF-8@AHT-1/8组显著促进细胞矿化和骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 小鼠拔牙后植入模型，结合组织学和基因表达验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve osseointegration of titanium implants by modifying the surface with a zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 coating.
summary_en.method: ZIF-8 crystals were grown on alkali- and heat-treated titanium substrates at varying concentrations, and the materials were characterized for physicochemical properties and osteogenic potential.
summary_en.result: The ZIF-8@AHT-1/8 coating significantly enhanced extracellular matrix mineralization, collagen secretion, and expression of osteogenic markers in vitro and promoted bone-implant integration in a mouse model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro MC3T3-E1 cell assays and in vivo implantation in healed mouse molars with histological and molecular analysis.

papers.title: ELFI: Engine for Likelihood-Free Inference
papers.abstract: Engine for Likelihood-Free Inference (ELFI) is a Python software library for performing likelihood-free inference (LFI). ELFI provides a convenient syntax for arranging components in LFI, such as priors, simulators, summaries or distances, to a network called ELFI graph. The components can be implemented in a wide variety of languages. The stand-alone ELFI graph can be used with any of the available inference methods without modifications. A central method implemented in ELFI is Bayesian Optimization for Likelihood-Free Inference (BOLFI), which has recently been shown to accelerate likelihood-free inference up to several orders of magnitude by surrogate-modelling the distance. ELFI also has an inbuilt support for output data storing for reuse and analysis, and supports parallelization of computation from multiple cores up to a cluster environment. ELFI is designed to be extensible and provides interfaces for widening its functionality. This makes the adding of new inference methods to ELFI straightforward and automatically compatible with the inbuilt features.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的BOLFI方法通过代理模型加速似然推断，可迁移用于生物力学FEA采样效率问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not specifically address FEA, implant design, constraints handling, or biomechanics; it is a general-purpose LFI software library.

summary_zh.motivation: 提供灵活的似然自由推断框架以加速基于仿真的推断。
summary_zh.method: 开发Python库ELFI，用图结构组织推断组件，集成BOLFI代理模型加速。
summary_zh.result: ELFI支持多核与集群并行，BOLFI可加速推断数个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准基准案例验证软件功能与加速效果。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a flexible and extensible software framework for likelihood-free inference that can accelerate simulation-based parameter estimation.
summary_en.method: ELFI implements a graph-based composition of LFI components and uses Bayesian Optimization for Likelihood-Free Inference (BOLFI) with surrogate modeling to reduce the number of simulator calls.
summary_en.result: The BOLFI method within ELFI achieves several orders of magnitude speedup in inference, and the library supports parallel execution and modular extension.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks and example applications typical for LFI, demonstrating correctness and computational gains.

papers.title: Effects of Cell Morphology and Heat Treatment on Impact Energy Absorption Property of Porous Aluminum Used for Landing Gears of a Small Satellite
papers.abstract: Energy absorbing system for landing gears is an important on the SLIM project. Open cell porous aluminum manufactured through 3D selective laser melting (SLM) process has been applied on the energy absorbing system. Compressive tests for cylindrical and hemispherical shaped porous aluminum with different porosities revealed the high potential as an energy absorbing component. Heat treatment after SLM processing is effective to increase the energy absorbing potential of the porous aluminum.

llm.relevance_to_user: 研究铝多孔材料用于卫星着陆器，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aluminum for satellite landing gear energy absorption, with no biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching for implants, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发卫星着陆器用多孔铝吸能材料。
summary_zh.method: SLM制备不同孔隙率多孔铝，并施加热处理。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著提高多孔铝的冲击吸能能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过圆柱和半球形试样的压缩实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an energy absorbing system for satellite landing gears using porous aluminum fabricated by SLM.
summary_en.method: Open-cell porous aluminum samples with cylindrical and hemispherical shapes and varying porosities were manufactured via selective laser melting, followed by heat treatment.
summary_en.result: Compressive tests showed that porous aluminum has high energy absorption potential, and heat treatment further enhances this property.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on SLM-fabricated porous aluminum samples validated the energy absorption performance.
